title: FinOps in my own words
steps: Read the FinOps Framework overview on finops.org
Write docs/notes/01-framework.md: the 6 principles, the personas, Inform / Optimize / Operate, crawl / walk / run, each in 1–2 lines in your own words
done: Notes file merged
You can explain the 3 phases to a non-engineer in 1 minute

title: Read a bill: FOCUS columns
focp: FOCUS, cost types (list, billed, effective, amortized)
steps: Run python demo/generate_sample.py and python demo/run_demo.py
Open demo/data/focus_sample.csv and reports/finops-report.html
Write docs/notes/02-focus.md: ListCost vs BilledCost vs EffectiveCost, PricingCategory, ChargeCategory, with one row from the CSV as an example
done: Notes merged
You can say why EffectiveCost is the number for showback

title: Deploy the AWS stack
steps: terraform/aws: copy tfvars example, terraform init, plan, apply
Create the FOCUS 1.0 export in the console (docs/setup.md step 2)
Confirm the SNS email
done: Export shows data in S3 (next day)
Screenshot of the export settings in docs/notes/03-deploy.md (hide the account ID)

title: Allocation and tagging
focp: Allocation, showback vs chargeback, shared cost
steps: Activate CostCenter, Environment, Owner as cost allocation tags
Tag your own resources through Terraform default_tags
Run sql/athena/00 then 01 and 02
done: Untagged % for your account written in docs/results.md
Notes: showback vs chargeback, and 2 ways to split shared cost

title: Reporting for each persona
steps: Connect Power BI Desktop (free) or QuickSight to Athena
Build 3 views: engineer (top resources), finance (month trend + variance), leadership (cost by product)
done: Screenshot of each view in docs/notes/05-reporting.md
One line per view: which persona, which decision it supports

title: Anomaly management
steps: Check Cost Anomaly Detection from Terraform is active
Run sql/athena/06
Write docs/notes/06-anomaly-runbook.md: who is told, in what time, what they check first
done: Runbook merged
Threshold choice explained (why that number)

title: Waste: orphaned resources
steps: Invoke the waste finder Lambda (dry run)
Read the S3 report
Create one unattached test volume, tag it finops:cleanup=approved, run with dry_run=false, see it removed
done: Real waste number in docs/results.md
Notes: why deletion needs a human approval tag

title: Right-sizing compute
steps: Opt in to Compute Optimizer
Install the CloudWatch agent on one instance so memory is visible
Compare its recommendation with what you see in CloudWatch
done: Notes: one recommendation you would accept and one you would not, and why

title: Rate optimization: commitments
focp: RIs, Savings Plans, coverage vs utilization, breakeven
steps: Run sql/athena/03
Read the Savings Plans recommendations in Cost Explorer
Write docs/notes/09-commitment-proposal.md for a fictional fleet: amount, term, coverage target, breakeven month, risks
done: Proposal merged
You can explain coverage vs utilization without notes

title: Kubernetes cost allocation
steps: Run python k8s/allocate.py on the sample
On a kind / minikube cluster: install metrics-server, apply k8s/policies in Audit mode, run collect_snapshot then allocate.py --kubectl-dir
Optional: install OpenCost (k8s/opencost)
done: Idle % and top over-requested pod written in docs/notes/10-k8s.md
Never commit a company cluster snapshot

title: AI token management
steps: Export your own AI tool usage (any provider) into the CSV shape in ai-tokens/token_report.py
Put real prices in a copy of prices.example.json
Run the report
done: One unit metric defined, e.g. cost per code review
Notes: 3 levers (caching, model routing, output caps) with expected effect

title: Azure side
steps: terraform/azure apply on a free / dev subscription
Run azure/orphaned_resources.kql
Create a FOCUS export in Azure Cost Management
done: Notes: what is the same and what differs between AWS and Azure billing

title: Forecast, budget and variance
steps: Run sql/athena/04
Forecast the next 3 months (trend + known changes)
Write a one-page variance note for 'Finance'
done: docs/notes/13-variance.md: top 5 changes, each with a technical reason and a cost number

title: Run the practice
steps: Write your own operating rhythm from docs/finops-rhythm.md
Score yourself crawl / walk / run on 5 capabilities
Take the FOCP exam
done: Maturity table in docs/notes/14-maturity.md
FOCP certificate
